title: Depth wallpaper with spatial clock occlusion
blurb: Composite a live editable HTML lock-screen clock and interactive widgets behind a sculptural foreground HTML and SVG cutout in one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas, with 3-plane parallax and toggleable depth occlusion.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas composite a live editable HTML lock-screen clock and quick widgets behind a foreground HTML and SVG cutout at distinct parallax depths while keeping clock controls clickable with updateElementGeometry()?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412x915, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass, 1.13 MP and 9.02 MB on one ElementGL context, 2 initial uploads with 0 re-uploads during Auto drift, zero CLS, and elementsFromPoint() hits the shifted input and widget button across parallax offsets. Chrome 159 on Android and check:jank stay not verified.
